input.goal: Should I buy a flat now or keep renting for a couple more years?

generated.verdict: Renting is the smarter move for now. You can comfortably afford a home in the ₹38L–₹46L range, but your savings cover only part of a healthy down payment. Renting ~18 more months while you build savings puts you in a much stronger position.

explained_terms.explanation: Equated Monthly Installment — the fixed amount you'd pay the bank each month. Yours would be about ₹32,500.
The upfront chunk you pay yourself (here ~20%). On a ₹42L home that's about ₹8.4L.
How many years you take to repay the loan. A longer tenure (here 20 years) means smaller monthly EMIs.
A bank's early estimate of how much it will lend you, before you pick a home.

next_steps: Keep renting and aim to save ~₹3L more over the next 12–18 months.
Park the down-payment savings in a low-risk option so it's ready when you are.
In ~12 months, get a loan pre-approval to confirm your real budget.
Re-run haus once your savings cross ₹10L to see if the verdict flips to 'buy'.
